article.story: UNIVERSITY PARK, Pa. -- — Ivan Juric had 21 points and a career-high 16 rebounds for his sixth straight game with a double-double and Penn State used a big second-half run to beat IU Indianapolis 81-74 on Wednesday night. It's the longest double-double streak to begin a season for Penn State since at least 1996-97. Juric scored the final six points of a 16-0 run to give Penn State a 65-54 lead — its first since it was 2-0 — with 7:39 left. Penn State had its lead trimmed to 67-64 with 3:47 left before Dasonte Bowen made a 3-pointer on back-to-back possessions to extend the advantage to six. A minute later, Thomas Allard sank his fifth 3-pointer — in just nine attempts. Bowen finished with 17 points and Allard added 15 for Penn State (5-1), which made a season-high 10 3-pointers. Juric reached 20 points for the second time this season. Billy Smith scored 18 points for IU Indianapolis (3-2). Kameron Tinsley had 14 of his 17 points in the first half. The first six baskets of the game for IU Indianapolis came from behind the arc. Tinsley completed a three-point play with eight minutes left to give IU Indianapolis a 29-19 lead, but Penn State chipped away to get within 41-40 at the break. The Jaguars were 9 of 20 from 3-point range in the first half and 5 of 12 inside the arc. Up next IU Indianapolis: Plays Maryland Eastern Shore in Youngstown, Ohio on Sunday. Penn State: Travels to the Bahamas for the Battle 4 Atlantis tournament against Memphis next Wednesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
